title: Reading a neuron's tuning from its correlations with other neurons
abstract: arXiv:2611.06927v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: What a neuron represents is usually established by relating its activity to a stimulus. We ask whether the same facts are contained in the correlation matrix of a recorded population, which keeps the pairwise relations among the neurons and discards the stimulus. A transformer that sees only the correlation matrix of 512 sampled neurons, with no labels and no reference population in its input, decodes the preferred orientation of mouse visual cortex neurons from in-vivo MICrONS responses to a mean error of 25{\deg} (uninformed: 45{\deg}; best constant guess: 41{\deg}) and their receptive-field position at R^2 = 0.23; on the digital-twin substrate, 20{\deg} and 0.48. Asked whether a neuron prefers horizontal or vertical, it is right for 79% of neurons in vivo and 87% on the twin, against 56% for the majority answer; it does not resolve the obliques. The ordering is recoverable because the relations between orientation classes are close

translated_title: 从神经元与其他神经元的相关性中读取其调谐特性
translated_abstract: 一个神经元所表征的内容，通常是通过将其活动与刺激相关联来确定的。我们探究同样的事实是否包含在所记录神经群的相关矩阵中——该矩阵保留了神经元之间的成对关系，而去除了刺激信息。一个只看到512个采样神经元相关矩阵的transformer模型（其输入中不含标签，也没有参考群体），从在体MICrONS响应中解码小鼠视觉皮层神经元的偏好朝向，平均误差为25°（无信息基线：45°；最佳常数猜测：41°），并以R² = 0.23的精度解码其感受野位置；在数字孪生基底上，误差为20°，R²为0.48。当被问及某个神经元偏好水平还是垂直朝向时，该模型在在体数据上对79%的神经元判断正确，在孪生数据上为87%，而多数回答的基线仅为56%；但它无法分辨倾斜朝向。这种排序之所以可以被恢复，是因为各朝向类别之间的关系是相近的……
tldr: 仅利用神经元群体的相关矩阵（不含刺激信息、无标签），transformer模型即可解码小鼠视觉皮层神经元的偏好朝向和感受野位置，表明神经元间的相关结构本身已蕴含其调谐特性信息。
en_tdlr: A transformer can decode mouse visual cortex neurons' preferred orientation and receptive-field position using only the population correlation matrix—with no stimulus, labels, or reference population—demonstrating that a neuron's tuning is recoverable from its correlations with other neurons.
